dialogue.say: Pick up the olive-oil bottle on the one large kitchen prep table, pour oil only over the pork hock on the pork-hock plate on that table, and return the oil bottle to the prep table. Turn on the kitchen oven, open it, pick up the pork-hock plate from the prep table, put the whole plate inside the kitchen oven, and close it.

Keep every clause already completed. If an earlier attempt to put the potato onto the frying pan was unstable, pick up that same potato where it remains visible beside the frying pan and retry placing it onto the pan; otherwise continue with the first unfinished clause. From the large prep table, pick up the olive-oil bottle on the large prep table, oil the potato on the potato plate on that table, and return the bottle. Pick up the potato from the potato plate on that table, put it onto the frying pan on the stove, and turn the stove on. Pick up the oil bottle again, oil the trout on the trout plate on the prep table, and return the bottle. Finally, pick up the paring knife on the large kitchen prep table, cut the pear on the pear plate on that table, and return the knife to the prep table.

Keep every clause already completed. If an earlier attempt to put the pear onto the frying pan was unstable, pick up that same pear where it remains visible beside the frying pan and retry placing it onto the pan; otherwise continue with the first unfinished clause. Cook the potato in the frying pan on the stove, pick up that cooked potato from the frying pan, and return it onto the potato plate on the large prep table. Then pick up the pear from the pear plate on that prep table and put it onto the same frying pan on the stove. Leave any completed dish already returned in place, and continue with the next unfinished step.

Cook the pork hock on the pork-hock plate inside the closed kitchen oven. Open the kitchen oven, pick up the pork-hock plate from inside the open kitchen oven, and place it back on the large prep table. From that same prep table, pick up the trout plate, put the whole plate inside the open kitchen oven, and close the door. Leave any completed plate already returned to the prep table in place, and continue with the next unfinished step.

Cook the pear in the frying pan on the stove, pick it up from that frying pan, return it onto the pear plate on the large prep table, and turn the stove off. Cook the trout on the trout plate inside the closed kitchen oven, turn the kitchen oven off, open it, pick up the trout plate from inside the open kitchen oven, return it to the large prep table, close the oven, and then wait through the remaining rest time. Leave any completed dish already returned in place, and continue with the next unfinished step.
